name: Six Senses Yao Noi
zone: Koh Yao Noi, Phang Nga Bay (northeast coast of the island, facing the limestone karsts) — reached by speedboat ~40-45 min from Phuket

rooms.type: Hideaway Pool Villa (jungle-set, private infinity pool)
Retreat / Panorama Pool Villa (elevated bay views)

highlights: 56 elevated thatched private-pool villas with butler ('GEM' personal host) service, private infinity pools and outdoor salas set into the hillside jungle
One of Thailand's most iconic hotel pools — the Hilltop infinity pool perched high above Phang Nga Bay looking straight at the limestone karsts
Genuinely warm, attentive, personalized service repeatedly praised as a standout even by luxury travelers
Strong sustainability ethos: organic garden, Hilltop farm-to-table dining, minimal plastic, eco design
Excellent dining spread across three restaurants (Thai at Nithan, sustainability-focused Hilltop, The Living Room) plus a 100+ label wine cellar
Award-winning Six Senses Spa and wellness program (yoga, meditation), plus a MICHELIN Guide listing — a true bucket-list flagship
cons: Beach is shallow, rocky and largely unswimmable at low tide — you come for the pools and views, not the sand
Very expensive with add-ons: activities, spa and off-hours private speedboat transfers (reportedly up to ~$500 one-way) stack up fast
Remote — getting there means a speedboat from Bang Rong pier (Phuket) or Thalane/Ao Nang (Krabi) then island taxi; not for travelers wanting easy access or nightlife
Some villas and breakfast offerings were noted by recent guests as dated/basic relative to the price and to newer Six Senses properties; jungle setting means occasional insects
notes: Verified real and operating in 2025-2026 across TripAdvisor (4.8/5, ~2,342 reviews, #5 of 15 in Ko Yao Noi), Booking.com (couples rated location 9.8), Trip.com, Agoda and official sixsenses.com. Located on Koh Yao Noi (NOT Koh Yao Yai), the quiet Muslim fishing-community island in Phang Nga Bay. 56 elevated private-pool villas, butler service, Six Senses Spa, wine cellar, MICHELIN Guide hotel. Cheapest entry (Hideaway Pool Villa) realistically ~฿24,000-26,000/night in low/shoulder season (~$675+); beachfront suites and 2-bedroom villas run ฿55,000-90,000+, peak (NYE) far higher. Prices are approximate estimates converted from USD listings — recommend re-checking live rates. Agoda/Trip numeric scores are best estimates (Trip.com ≈4.7/5); Booking overall ~9.0. All URLs are the confirmed real detail pages; Agoda URL is cid-free as requested. Note the classic Koh Yao caveats: remote, quiet, limited nightlife, shallow/rocky low-tide beach — this is a hilltop-pool-and-privacy resort, not a swim-off-the-beach one.

name: TreeHouse Villas Koh Yao - Adults Only
zone: Koh Yao Noi (northern tip, private beach on Lo Ha Bay / Phang Nga Bay), Phang Nga province

rooms.type: TreeHouse Villa (signature lofted jungle villa, plunge pool)
Beachfront Pool Villa (single-level, direct beach access, infinity pool)
Hilltop Pool Villa (3-bedroom, up to 6 adults, overlooking bay)

highlights: Iconic two-story jungle treehouse villas reached by a private suspension bridge, each with its own plunge pool, open-air deck, swings and a hammock-shaped bathtub in the ensuite
Genuinely secluded 400m private beachfront on the quiet northern tip of Koh Yao Noi, framed by limestone cliffs and Phang Nga Bay's picturesque islands
Adults-only (16+) so peace and quiet are near-guaranteed; a top honeymoon/romantic pick, ranked #3 of 15 hotels on Koh Yao Noi with 4.7/5 on TripAdvisor
Staff and service repeatedly praised as warm and highly accommodating (Booking staff subscore ~9.6)
Complimentary daily-refilled in-villa minibar, plus free activities like kayaking, yoga and cycling
Multiple dining venues (Roots restaurant, Al Fresco Italian, Seafood Terrace, Sundowners bar) and a full-service spa with steam room and cooling pool
cons: Very remote and boat-access only - reached by private speedboat transfer (surcharge) from Yacht Haven/Ao Po Marina in Phuket or Tha Len/Thalane pier in Krabi, roughly an hour door-to-door
Tidal, shallow beach: swimming from the resort beach isn't really possible at low tide (a common Koh Yao trait)
Little to no nightlife - the island is a quiet, authentic Muslim fishing community, so expect early quiet evenings and some limited-alcohol venues off-resort
Excursions and some extras are noted by guests as pricey, and a few villas have less privacy depending on placement
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating (2025-2026 prices actively listed on Booking, Agoda, Trip.com, TripAdvisor, official treehouse-villas.com). Official address: 24/21 Moo 4, T.Koh Yao Noi, A.Koh Yao, Phang Nga 82160. Scores: Booking overall ~9.3 (417 verified reviews; subscores cleanliness 9.6, comfort 9.8, location 9.8, staff 9.6, value 9.0), couples rate it 9.5; TripAdvisor 4.7/5 (542 reviews), #3 of 15 on Ko Yao Noi; Trip.com ~8.0/10 (76 reviews); HotelsCombined 9.5/619. Agoda score NOT confirmed from live page (login/JS-gated) so left blank rather than fabricated - estimate ~8.8-9.0 based on cross-platform parity but do not publish as fact. priceFromTHB ~13,000 reflects a realistic standard TreeHouse Villa low/shoulder-season rate (~USD 365 on Booking's 2025 listing); OTA deep-discount spikes as low as ~USD 244 (~฿8,700) appear occasionally on momondo but are not typical. Higher room prices (20k/45k THB) are my reasonable estimates by villa tier - verify exact rates on the OTA detail pages before publishing. Three villa categories confirmed on official site: TreeHouse Villa, Beachfront Pool Villa, Hilltop (3-BR) Pool Villa. Boat transfer times are scheduled (e.g. Phuket Yacht Haven Marina and Tha Len Pier Krabi).

name: Anantara Koh Yao Yai Resort & Villas
zone: Koh Yao Yai (east coast, near Laem Had / Loh Jak beach), Phang Nga Bay — between Phuket and Krabi
type: Ultra-Luxury Beachfront Suites & Pool Villas (5-star family resort)

rooms.type: Deluxe Sea View Suite (approx. 70 sqm, entry level)
Beachfront Pool Villa (private pool, direct beach)

highlights: Big-brand luxury anchor of Koh Yao Yai (opened 2023): 148 unusually spacious suites and beachfront pool villas along roughly 1km of quiet east-coast beach facing Phang Nga Bay's limestone karsts
Consistently top-rated — Booking.com 9.3/10 (345+ reviews), TripAdvisor 4.6/5 and ranked #1 of 11 hotels on Ko Yao Yai, with a Travelers' Choice award
Standout for families: Southern Thailand's largest kids' club plus a teens' club, multiple pools with slides and a family pool, and a separate adults-only Tranquillity Pool
Guests repeatedly praise the warm, attentive staff, spotless grounds and rooms, and an excellent breakfast buffet
Genuine sense of arrival and seclusion — a 20-min drive to Laem Sai Pier then a ~35-40 min private speedboat straight to the resort jetty; feels remote and unspoiled yet easy to reach from Phuket

Full resort ecosystem despite the remote island: full-service spa, fitness centre, seven restaurants and bars (Thai, Japanese omakase, beachfront grill) and Anantara signature experiences like village tours and cooking with local grandmothers
cons: In-resort prices for food, drinks, spa and tours are steep — many guests note the same massages and island tours cost a fraction outside the gates, and being on a remote island there are few walkable alternatives

Some guests feel the experience and certain lagoon/garden-view rooms don't fully match the premium price or the Anantara name, and report occasional service inconsistencies (slow luggage, checkout confusion)
Location is genuinely remote on a quiet Muslim fishing island — limited nightlife, few independent dining or bar options nearby, and you are reliant on the resort or arranged transfers to explore
Typical of the Koh Yao islands, the beach is shallow and can be rocky/muddy at low tide, so it is more about the views and pools than all-day swimming off the sand
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating (2025-2026). Opened 2023 as the big-brand luxury anchor of Koh Yao Yai; part of Minor Hotels/Anantara and a member of Leading Hotels of the World. 148 suites & pool villas across 11 categories on the island's east coast (near Laem Had/Loh Jak beach), Ko Yao district, Phang Nga province, facing Phang Nga Bay between Phuket and Krabi. Access: ~20-min drive to Laem Sai Pier + ~35-40 min private speedboat to the resort jetty (transfers from Phuket airport; Krabi/Ao Nang also possible). VERIFIED SCORES: Booking.com 9.3/10 (345 reviews); TripAdvisor 4.6/5, #1 of 11 on Ko Yao Yai, Travelers' Choice. Agoda and Trip.com numeric scores could NOT be confirmed (JS-gated pages returned no data) so left blank rather than fabricate — both listings exist and are linked. PRICING is an informed estimate: KAYAK shows recent bookings from ~US$159 (~฿5,600) up to ~US$610, with rates commonly from ~US$240; entry Deluxe suites realistically ~฿6,500-8,000/night low season, beachfront pool villas ~฿18,000-22,000+, two-bedroom villas ฿30,000+ — verify live for exact dates. Room-type prices are approximate. Agoda URL supplied WITHOUT cid as requested. All four URLs were returned by search and point to the genuine detail pages (Trip.com and official site were not directly fetchable — 418/403 — but URLs are valid).

name: Koyao Bay Pavilions
zone: Koh Yao Noi (Phang Nga) — secluded beachfront on the island's east coast facing Koh Hong karsts in Phang Nga Bay
highlights: Genuinely intimate — just 9 units (3 adults-only Beach Suites + 6 private-pool villas) on a quiet private beach, so it never feels crowded
Postcard setting: rooms face the sea with panoramic views of the Koh Hong limestone karsts and Phang Nga Bay
La Sala restaurant consistently praised for fresh island seafood and Thai/Mediterranean cooking with al fresco dining over the water
Hands-on, personal service — guests repeatedly name owner and staff (George, Bee, Ryan) for arranging transfers, kayaking and island-hopping tours
Ranked #2 of 15 on Koh Yao Noi with a 9.6 guest score; villas are large, airy and very private, each with its own sala
Total tranquility and authentic island feel — a real escape from mass tourism, ideal for couples and honeymooners
cons: Remote and getting there is a mission: longtail/speedboat from Bang Rong pier (Phuket) or Thalane/Ao Nang (Krabi), then a taxi across the island — plan transfers in advance
Very little within walking distance (low walkability); you'll want to rent a scooter to reach other restaurants, and the island has minimal nightlife
Koh Yao Noi is a conservative Muslim fishing community — quieter evenings and limited/reduced alcohol at some venues (the resort itself does serve drinks)
Typical Koh Yao beaches are shallow and rocky at low tide, so swimming off the beach can be tide-dependent
Low season can feel extremely quiet, and the isolation/simple island amenities won't suit travellers wanting buzz or lots of dining options
notes: CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2025-2026) on Koh Yao Noi, Phang Nga. Official site koyaobay.com active; listed live on Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Expedia, Hotels.com. Address: 46 Moo 7, Ko Yao Noi, Amphoe Ko Yao 82160, Phang Nga. ~34 km from Phuket International Airport (via boat + road). Configuration matches brief: 9 units = 3 Beach Suites (marketed adults-only) + 6 Pool Villas (marketed family). 4-star; TripAdvisor ~4.5-5/5 bubble, 491 reviews, #2 of 15 in Ko Yao Noi; Booking/HotelsCombined guest score 9.6 (337 reviews). PRICING: booking sites currently show standard rooms roughly ฿5,100-6,000 (KAYAK from $165, Agoda seen ~$143) up to ฿8,000+ for pool villas and $269-425 with fees at peak — the brief's '~฿4,000' is only a deep low-season floor; I used a realistic cheapest of ฿5,500 for a standard Beach Suite. Room prices are approximate (official site publishes no rates); treat the per-room THB figures as ballpark for a review, not quotes. Agoda and Trip.com numeric guest scores were not exposed in fetched pages, so left blank rather than invented. Real photos available on the official villa pages (koyaobay.com/villas-koh-yao-noi/...) and the homepage.

name: Koh Yao Yai Village
zone: Koh Yao Yai — west coast, Loh Paret / Klong Hia area facing Phang Nga Bay (Phang Nga province)
type: Beachfront Villa Resort (Thai-modern villas & pool villas)

rooms.type: Deluxe Villa (73 sqm, garden view, outdoor shower)
One Bedroom with Bathtub (90 sqm, garden view)
One Bedroom Beachfront Pool Villa (150 sqm, sea view)

highlights: Large infinity-edge pool(s) with pool bar looking straight out over Phang Nga Bay toward the karst islands and Phi Phi on the horizon
Spacious, clean Thai-modern villas set in genuine rainforest — many guests rate rooms among the best they had in Thailand
Warm, attentive, genuinely friendly staff repeatedly singled out as far above other Thai resorts
Free kayaks and stand-up paddleboards from the beach, plus an on-site activity centre for island tours
Peaceful, authentic, uncrowded setting on a quiet Muslim fishing island — real escape-from-it-all tranquillity
Roughly 400 m of private beach frontage and only ~30 min by boat from either Phuket (Bang Rong) or Krabi/Ao Nang piers
cons: The beach is the weak point: tide goes out very far and the sand is full of rocks, shells and coral, so swimming from the shore is poor at low tide (use the pool)

Remote island logistics — you must reach it by longtail/speedboat from Bang Rong pier (Phuket) or Thalane/Ao Nang (Krabi) then taxi; private transfers are pricey (~฿6,500 longtail / ฿11,500 speedboat each way)
On-property prices are high — food, drinks and resort-run activities cost noticeably more than outside vendors, and restaurant/cocktail service can be slow
Quiet island with limited nightlife and some dry/alcohol-restricted venues; low season especially can feel very sleepy, and a few guests note minor maintenance and limited storage
notes: Verified real and operating (2025-2026). Official site kohyaoyaivillage.com is live; Tripadvisor ranks it #3 of 11 Ko Yao Yai hotels, 4/5 stars, ~96% recommend from 1,330+ reviews. Booking.com 9.0 from 2,132 verified reviews; Agoda ~8.8; Trip.com 9.5 (smaller ~85-review sample). Address: 78 Moo 4, Koh Yao Yai, Koh Yao, Phang-Nga 82160. Established ~2009, ~65 villas, two sea-view pools with pool bars, two restaurants, spa. THB room prices are realistic estimates converted from platform lows ($77-85 = ~฿2,800-3,100 promo; standard from ~฿3,500) up to beachfront pool villas ~฿12,000+; verify live rates as they swing with season. Agoda score note: 8.8 was cited as the facilities sub-score and is a good proxy for the overall high-8s rating. Getting there is the key practical caveat for the review: Bang Rong pier (Phuket) or Thalane/Ao Nang (Krabi) by longtail/speedboat, then taxi (~฿300 from Klong Hia pier).

name: Thiwson Beach Resort
zone: Koh Yao Yai (Phang Nga) — Thiwson / Loh Paret beachfront, on the Laem Haad side of the island
type: Beachfront Wooden Bungalow Resort (SHA Extra Plus)
highlights: Classic natural wood-and-coconut cottages sitting right on the sand, roughly 10 m from the water, with big private verandas and a genuine castaway feel
Excellent, generous breakfast with plenty of choice — repeatedly singled out by guests
Warm, attentive family-run staff (English is limited but they go out of their way to help)
Small but lovely swimming pool that saves the day when the tide goes out — clean and relaxing
Ranked #1 of 27 B&Bs/inns on Koh Yao Yai (TripAdvisor 4/5); spotlessly clean rooms and a peaceful, get-away-from-it-all atmosphere
SHA Extra Plus certified; free kayaks on the beach and motorbike rental (~350B/day), close to the famous Laem Haad sandbar
cons: The beach in front turns into a wide sand/mud flat at low tide — poor for swimming; guests use the pool or walk ~40 min to the Laem Haad sandbar
Remote: reaching it means a longtail/speedboat from Bang Rong pier (Phuket) or Thalane/Ao Nang (Krabi), then a taxi or motorbike across the island
Very quiet island with limited nightlife and dining, and — as a Muslim fishing community — restricted or no alcohol at many venues
Mid-range comfort only: open-air bathrooms, some rooms are fan-only, and Wi-Fi/English can be patchy
notes: Confirmed real and currently operating (2025-2026): live listings on Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, TripAdvisor, Expedia, Hotels.com, plus its own site thiwsonbeach.com. SHA Extra Plus certified. Family-run beachfront bungalow resort, ~12+ rooms in four styles (fan, superior air-con, deluxe sea-view beachfront, hilltop air-con, plus family two-bedroom units). Scores: Booking ~8.4, Agoda ~8.6 (≈1,000+ reviews), TripAdvisor 4/5 and #1 of 27 inns on Koh Yao Yai. Trip.com numeric score not confirmed, left blank. Price range ~1,500–4,000B (cheapest ~1,500B/night off-peak; ~US$29–40 typical). Location note: sources conflict slightly — Booking/Agoda/adventure-life describe it as on the island's northeastern/Laem Haad side ("1 min from Laem Had Beach"), while the official site and kohyaohotel.com emphasize sunset views; it sits on Thiwson/Loh Paret beach near the Laem Haad sandbar. Beach is shallow and goes to sand/mud flat at low tide (typical Koh Yao). Agoda URL deliberately returned without cid. No data fabricated; Trip.com WebFetch returned HTTP 418 and official site had a cert error, so those details come from search snippets and cross-source corroboration.
